data.name: Malikah
data.gender_notes: Malikah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Malikah means a queen or a female ruler, symbolizing strength and leadership. It is derived from the Arabic word 'malik,' meaning king. The name Malikah carries the meaning “Queen or Ruler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Malikah usually hope their child will grow to embody queen or ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Malikah represents a righteous and just leader, guiding others with wisdom and compassion.
data.etymology: Malikah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Queen or Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Malikah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: مَلِکَہ
in_arabic.long_meaning: مَلِکَہ هي اسم علم مؤنث يأتي من الجذر العربي ملك، الذي يعني الملك أو الحاكم، وتستخدم لوصف المرأة القوية والصاحبة الجيدة، ويرتبط بالعديد من الشخصيات التاريخية والدينية المهمة في التراث الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: ملیکہ
in_urdu.meaning: عورت کی طاقت اور اچھی ساتھی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ملیکہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو ملک سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب بادشاہ یا حاکم ہوتا ہے، اور یہ عورت کی طاقت اور اچھی ساتھی کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اس سے منسلک کئی اہم تاریخی اور مذہبی شخصیات ہیں

in_hindi.name: मालिका
in_hindi.meaning: महिला की ताकत और अच्छी साथी
in_hindi.long_meaning: मालिका एक अरबी नाम है जो मालिक से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ राजा या शासक होता है, और यह महिला की ताकत और अच्छी साथी के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है, और इसके साथ जुड़े कई महत्वपूर्ण ऐतिहासिक और धार्मिक व्यक्तियों हैं

in_pashto.name: مليکه

in_english.name: Malikah
in_english.long_meaning: Malikah is an Arabic name derived from the root malik, meaning king or ruler, and it is used to describe a strong and good companion woman, and it is associated with many important historical and religious figures in Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: Malikah has historical significance as the name of legendary queens, such as Malikah bint Al-Ru'ain in Arabic folklore, known for her power and wisdom. It reflects the importance of women in leadership roles in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: Malikah holds spiritual significance in the context of the Islamic concept of Al-Malik, the All-Powerful King - Allah (God). Being named Malikah, could signify a deep connection between the person and the divine, linking their earthly experiences to the eternal presence of the Supreme Ruler, Al-Malik Allah.
